## Plotting features of the weighted co-expression networks generated

This archived report records the diagnostic plotting calls now exposed by
Stage 3. Advanced users should call `draw_network_dendrogram()` and
`draw_eigengene_network()` directly from R code.

Load the standardized network result supplied by the caller:

```{r}
network_result <- readRDS(
  file.path(session_dir, "out", "3_networks.rds")
)

net <- network_result$network
net_km <- network_result$network_kmeans
```

```{r}
# Plot the dendrogram for each block and the module colors underneath

for (i in 1:length(net$blockGenes)){
  plotDendroAndColors(
    net$dendrograms[[i]],
    net$colors[net$blockGenes[[i]]],
    "HC Modules",
    dendroLabels = FALSE,
    hang = 0.03,
    addGuide = TRUE,
    guideHang = 0.05 )
}
```

```{r}
GenModPlot <- plot_genes_in_modules(net, title = "Number of Genes in Modules by HC")
GenModPlot_km <- plot_genes_in_modules(net_km, title = "Number of Genes in Modules by k-means")
print(GenModPlot)
print(GenModPlot_km)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(session_dir, "plots", "3_genes_in_modules_HC.png"),
  plot = GenModPlot,
  width = 8,          # Width in inches
  height = 6,         # Height in inches
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(session_dir, "plots", "3_genes_in_modules_KM.png"),
  plot = GenModPlot_km,
  width = 8,          # Width in inches
  height = 6,         # Height in inches
  dpi = 600,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
pdf(file = file.path(session_dir, "plots", "3_modules_HC_eigengenes.pdf"), 
  width = 8,          # Width in inches
  height = 6,         # Height in inches
  bg = "white")

plotEigengeneNetworks(orderMEs(net$MEs),
                      setLabels = "HC modules",
                      marDendro=c(0,4,1,2), 
                      marHeatmap=c(3,4,1,2),
                      cex.lab=0.8,
                      xLabelsAngle=90,
                      plotPreservation = "standard")
dev.off()

pdf(file = file.path(session_dir, "plots", "3_modules_KM_eigengenes.pdf"), 
  width = 8,          # Width in inches
  height = 6,         # Height in inches
  bg = "white")
plotEigengeneNetworks(orderMEs(net_km$MEs),
                      "KM modules",
                      marDendro=c(0,4,1,2), 
                      marHeatmap=c(3,4,1,2),
                      cex.lab=0.8,
                      xLabelsAngle=90,
                      plotPreservation = "standard")
dev.off()
```
